name: File Organization & Housekeeping
purpose: Organize files into a structure the user finds natural, without destroying or moving anything they did not ask about.
summary: Work knowledge for tidying a working folder: learn the existing convention first, propose a structure that matches it, move only what was asked, and prove the result is intact.
applicable_context: tidying or sorting a working folder
setting up a repeatable folder structure
renaming or relocating files as part of larger work
knowledge: inspect the existing folder layout before deciding on a structure
infer the user's naming and grouping convention and follow it
plan the whole move set first, then apply it
never move, rename, or delete files outside the requested scope
avoid names that are illegal or awkward on the target filesystem
keep related files together rather than flattening everything
prerequisites: the scope of what may be moved is agreed
verification_guidance: confirm each intended file exists at its new path
confirm nothing was lost by comparing counts before and after
confirm the resulting structure matches the plan
recovery_guidance: if a move fails partway, stop and report which items landed where
never overwrite an existing file during reorganization
if the convention is unclear, keep the current layout and ask
